title: Here’s Who Caught Taylor Swift’s Bouquet at the Pop Star’s Wedding to Travis Kelce
summary: The arrangement appeared to include sweet peas and Queen Anne's lace.
contentText:
Hey, thank you for the lovely bouquet! In keeping with tradition, Taylor Swift apparently tossed her bouquet into the crowd of unmarried women at her and Travis Kelce ‘s wedding over Fourth of July weekend — and one of them has now come forward as the lucky lady who caught it.

Related

Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce’s Wedding Vows: What Guests Have Revealed

In a Sunday (July 5) post on Instagram , Ashley Smith — whose brother is Kelce’s teammate Trey Smith — revealed that the pop superstar’s floral arrangement landed in her hands during the toss. “Celebrated an Enchanting Love S(T&T)ory,” she wrote, sharing photos of herself in her black evening gown.

“And somehow…I ended up catching Tay Tay’s bouquet,” Ashley continued. “So here’s to believing it’s bringing a lifetime of love, luck, and laughter my way. Congratulations, Taylor & Travis! Cheers to forever T&T!”

She also shared a couple of photos of herself holding the bouquet. Based on the snaps, Swift walked down the aisle holding what appeared to be a collection of sweet peas and Queen Anne’s lace.

The ceremony took place on Friday (July 3) at Madison Square Garden with numerous people in attendance. Insiders have said that the event featured tearful wedding vows from the newlyweds — with Swift apparently singing part of hers — as well as performances from Paul McCartney and Stevie Nicks at the reception.

“JUST&T MARRIED,” read the screens outside of the New York City arena after the singer and Kelce tied the knot, announcing the news to the world. Shortly afterward, Swift’s rep announced that in lieu of a traditional wedding party, she was joined by brother Austin Swift as her man of honor while the Kansas City Chiefs tight end’s brother, Jason Kelce, served as his best man. Adam Sandler officiated.

“I really can’t say a heck of a lot except it was magical, man,” Travis’ mom, Donna, said of the event the following day while enjoying the Macy’s fireworks display. “Magical.”
